import { setTimeout as sleep } from "node:timers/promises";

export async function waitAliased(flush: () => void, signal?: AbortSignal) {
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  setTimeout(flush, 0);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await sleep();
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await sleep(0);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await sleep(undefined, 0, { signal });
  await sleep(200);
  await sleep(200, 0);
  setTimeout(flush, 200);
}
